latency.definition: Wall-clock time per request, after any client-side warmup, covering the network call.

cost.source: OpenRouter usage.cost (or equivalent billed field) from each response. Never estimated after the fact.

calibration.probability_source: model probability vector (decision-model probabilities, or softmax over logprobs). Self-reported confidence is not used.

run_note: Interrupted at about 12:50:02 IST (Asia/Calcutta) by an uncaught RemoteDisconnected on the request after s028/ta. Resumed at 12:50:46 IST. Four billed items (s027/ta, s028/en, s028/hi, s028/ta) were recovered from the log so they were not re-billed; those four have accuracy and cost but no saved probability vector or latency.
